The climate in Shkodër

Shkodër is about 16 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 33°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 2°C. Around 1770 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 282 mm). The highest temperature in Shkodër in 2015–2024 was 41°C (4 August 2017) and the lowest −9°C (8 January 2017).

Best time to visit Shkodër

The most pleasant weather in Shkodër is usually in May, September and October: average highs are between 22°C and 27°C, with up to 12 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
